Available Commands:
  certificate     Set/rotate the TLS certificate for the Octelium Cluster
  init            Initialize and install an Octelium Cluster

## `octops certificate`

```text
Set/rotate the TLS certificate for the Octelium Cluster

Usage:
  octops certificate [DOMAIN] [flags]

Aliases:
  certificate, cert, crt

Examples:

octops crt example.com --cert /path/to/tls.crt --key /path/to/tls.key
octops cert octelium.example.com --kubeconfig /path/to/kueconfig --cert /path/to/tls.crt --key /path/to/tls.key
octops certificate sub.octelium.example.com  --kubeconfig /path/to/kueconfig --cert /path/to/tls.crt --key /path/to/tls.key

Flags:
      --cert string          TLS PEM certificate file path
      --key string           TLS cert key file path
      --kubeconfig string    kubeconfig file path
      --kubecontext string   kubecontext
      --namespace string     Set a Cluster TLS certificate for a certain Octelium Namespace
```

## `octops init`

```text
Initialize and install an Octelium Cluster on top of a Kubernetes cluster using a bootstrap file

Usage:
  octops init [DOMAIN] [flags]

Examples:

octops init example.com --bootstrap /path/to/bootstrap.yaml
octops init octelium.example.com --kubeconfig /path/to/kueconfig --bootstrap /path/to/bootstrap.yaml
octops init sub.octelium.example.com  --kubeconfig /path/to/kueconfig --bootstrap /path/to/bootstrap.yaml

Flags:
      --bootstrap string     Bootstrap configuration file path
      --kubeconfig string    kubeconfig file path (Default path is $HOME/.kube/config)
      --kubecontext string   kubecontext
      --version string       The desired Octelium Cluster version to be installed
```

## `octops install-package`

```text
Install or upgrade an Octelium Cluster package

Usage:
  octops install-package [DOMAIN] [flags]

Examples:

octops install-package example.com --package octeliumee
octops install-package octelium.example.com --package cordium --kubeconfig /path/to/kueconfig

Flags:
      --kubeconfig string    kubeconfig file path
      --kubecontext string   kubecontext
      --package string       Package name. Currently the values "octeliumee", "cordium" are available
      --upgrade              Upgrade an already installed package
      --version string       Package version. By default it is set to "latest"
```

## `octops uninstall`

```text
Uninstall your Octelium Cluster

Usage:
  octops uninstall [DOMAIN] [flags]

Examples:

octops uninstall example.com
octops uninstall octelium.example.com --kubeconfig /path/to/kueconfig
octops uninstall sub.octelium.example.com  --kubeconfig /path/to/kueconfig

Flags:
      --kubeconfig string    kubeconfig file path
      --kubecontext string   kubecontext
```

## `octops upgrade`

```text
Upgrade your Octelium Cluster

Usage:
  octops upgrade [DOMAIN] [flags]

Examples:

octops upgrade example.com
octops upgrade octelium.example.com --kubeconfig /path/to/kueconfig
octops upgrade sub.octelium.example.com  --kubeconfig /path/to/kueconfig

Flags:
      --check                Check whether there is a more recent latest release without actually upgrading the Cluster
      --kubeconfig string    kubeconfig file path
      --kubecontext string   kubecontext
      --version string       The desired Octelium Cluster version. By default it is set to "latest"
      --wait                 Wait until the upgrade is complete
```

## `octops version`

```text
Print version information

Usage:
  octops version [flags]

Flags:
      --check        Check whether there is a more recent latest release for Octelium CLIs
  -o, --out string   Output format (json|yaml) (default "yaml")
```
